_readme: Reference code meant to be COPIED, not only imported. Every file here is stored byte-identical to
what a consumer would paste into their own project, and `fhevm-npm sync-vendored` writes each destination.
ethereumLibTypes.ts is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for the adapter interfaces. Each generation receives a copy
in pkg/ts/types/ and its public.ts re-exports from that copy instead of declaring the types, so there
is one definition in the workspace and the byte check below is what proves every copy matches.
cleartext-config.ts is itself GENERATED — `fhevm-npm generate-cleartext-config` renders it from
sdk/cleartext-config.json, the source of truth for the cleartext stack's shared values — and each
generation receives a copy in pkg/ts/. Regenerate before syncing; `make generate` runs both in order.
A published payload cannot depend on a private workspace member, so it gets copies too. Members that
are never published just import @fhevm/sdk-vendored-dev/<file>.ts instead.
